pitfalls.summary: _createdDate and _updatedDate are read-only; preserve source dates in explicit fields.
Bulk Save replaces complete items, so generated records must include all fields.

mappingGuidance: Use client-supplied IDs where possible for recoverable CMS imports.

Large-volume alternative: the Data Movement Jobs API imports a file into a collection as an async job (Submit Job + Create File Upload Url). Per-item API writes stay preferred — deterministic per-row errors and crosswalk stamping — but evaluate the job channel live when a collection import is large enough that per-item calls dominate the run.
setupRequirements: Target collection exists before item writes.

evidence.note: file-to-collection bulk import jobs; evaluated at the docs-survey sweep 2026-08-11
